name: card
description: A bordered surface for one thing: an optional figure that bleeds to the edges, a body, and a footer that sits at the bottom; a row with the picture beside the text once the card's content reaches the md width.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: Tints the border and adds a bar along the top; the body stays plain.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: The card's own width from which the picture sits beside the text instead of on top.

attributes.name: data-ratio
attributes.description: The picture's aspect ratio while it sits on top of the body. Past data-threshold the picture moves beside the body and fills that column, and the ratio stops applying.

attributes.name: data-raised
attributes.description: A shadow instead of a border.

children.description: A figure first if there is one, then the body, then an optional footer.
A figure element holding media and a caption; only the media is cropped.
Actions, pushed to the bottom of the card; in a grid with data-rows it takes the last row.
One link that is stretched over the whole card, so the card is clickable while the link keeps its own name.

markers.name: data-stretch
markers.description: Stretches the link over the whole card, so the card is clickable while the link keeps its own name.

tokens.name: --yeti-card-padding
tokens.description: Padding inside the card; the figure bleeds through it.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text
tokens.description: The card's text, and a caption laid over the figure.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: Border width; the variant's bar is four of them.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-scrim
tokens.description: Wash behind a caption laid over the figure, so it stays readable.

a11y.notes: Never wrap a card in a link: the whole card's text would become the link's name. Put the link on the heading and give it data-stretch so the card is clickable and the link is named by the heading. Use article for cards that stand alone and li for cards in a list.
